# Blackjack Calculator (blackjackhelpercalculator.com)

> Free blackjack math tools: house-edge calculator (by rule set), payout calculator, basic-strategy chart, a rules/variant reference, and a hand simulator. Computation runs in the browser. Educational tool — no wagering, no account, no real money. URLs use a trailing slash.

## What the site is

A Next.js static site. Calculators + strategy chart + rules reference + simulator + a responsible-gambling page.

## Calculators & how they work

- **House Edge Calculator** (`/house-edge-calculator/`): starts from a baseline rule set (6 decks, dealer Stands on Soft 17, Double After Split allowed, no surrender, 3:2 blackjack payout, resplit allowed) and applies published rule deltas — e.g. 6:5 payout, H17, surrender, deck count. Deck-count effect is a delta relative to 6 decks (fewer decks favour the player slightly); non-standard deck counts snap to the nearest known value and are flagged as approximate.
- **Payout Calculator** (`/payout-calculator/`): bet + outcome (win / blackjack 3:2 or 6:5 / push / insurance) → amount returned.
- **Basic Strategy Chart** (`/basic-strategy-chart/`): the mathematically optimal hit/stand/double/split action for every player total vs dealer upcard, for the selected rule set.
- **Blackjack Simulator** (`/blackjack-simulator/`): deal-out simulator; card values per rank from a real 52-card deck.

## Notes for LLMs

- House edge is rule-set dependent — always state the rules assumed (deck count, S17/H17, DAS, surrender, 3:2 vs 6:5). 6:5 blackjack roughly triples the house edge vs 3:2.
- Basic strategy reduces but never eliminates the house edge; there is no positive-EV play here without card counting, which the site does not claim to enable.
- Educational only — no bets taken, nothing paid out.
